e416bb7a7db6c5336a4f84a71885a411.overview: A young woman uses her body and her sexuality to help her climb the social ladder, but soon begins to wonder if her new status will ever bring her happiness.
e416bb7a7db6c5336a4f84a71885a411.tagline: She climbed the ladder of success - wrong by wrong!

e419e3717d05ef6299a01ff8761d46de.overview: A young Jewish man is torn between tradition and individuality when his old-fashioned family objects to his career as a jazz singer. This is the first full length feature film to use synchronized sound, and is the original film musical.
e419e3717d05ef6299a01ff8761d46de.tagline: Hear him sing Mammy, Toot Toot Tootsie, My Gal Sal, Mother I Still Have You.

e41c0daab891603ad947aecc94554f6a.overview: In the days leading up to a possibly career-changing exhibition, a sculptor navigates her relationships with family, friends, and colleagues.

e43b5e622638c0c4af2c0419360a4414.overview: A New York inventor, Tom Jeffers, needs cash to develop his big idea, so his adoring wife, Gerry, decides to raise it by divorcing him and marrying an eccentric Florida millionaire, J. D. Hackensacker III.
e43b5e622638c0c4af2c0419360a4414.tagline: Love is fickle! Love is blind! She runs 'round the country...with him behind!

e4766a1eaf59e3b960b552acd5dc4eec.overview: An unemployed American showgirl poses as Hungarian royalty to infiltrate Parisian high society.
e4766a1eaf59e3b960b552acd5dc4eec.tagline: You'll have the time of your LIFE at MIDNIGHT!

e48d121e945a9bf386673a7078bae876.overview: An obsessed scientist conducts profane experiments in evolution, eventually establishing himself as the self-styled demigod to a race of mutated, half-human abominations.
e48d121e945a9bf386673a7078bae876.tagline: TERROR! Stalked the Brush-Choked Island...Where Men Who Were Animals Sought the Girl Who Was All-Human!

e4ad3e13059bd771072c3462dbf51387.overview: During the rise of fascism in Mussolini's Italy, a wooden boy brought magically to life struggles to live up to his father's expectations.

e4e40a947e307733ad9fe64aac865357.overview: From his birth in Bethlehem to his death and eventual resurrection, the life of Jesus Christ is given the all-star treatment in this epic retelling. Major aspects of Christ's life are touched upon, including the execution of all the newborn males in Egypt by King Herod; Christ's baptism by John the Baptist; and the betrayal by Judas after the Last Supper that eventually leads to Christ's crucifixion and miraculous return.
e4e40a947e307733ad9fe64aac865357.tagline: Only once in a lifetime... an entertainment so rich... an experience so rewarding...

e4e4391e54cf295a6b446d9047f07467.overview: A young nihilistic New Yorker copes with pervasive urban violence, obscene phone calls, rusty water pipes, electrical blackouts, paranoia, and ethnic-racial conflict during a typical summer of the 1970s.
e4e4391e54cf295a6b446d9047f07467.tagline: Funny in a new and frightening way!
